notes.title: Steam Page is now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm very excited to share that the Steam page for Void Scavengers is now live.

This is a huge milestone for me - I've invested lots of time and effort on this project and I'm very happy with its current state. Below you can find some additional information!

[h2]About the developer[/h2]
I'm @isikdev - an Unreal Engine developer & enthusiast. I love creating immersive & fun stuff. I've been working with Unreal for ~5 years and I finally decided to publish a game on Steam. Thus, Void Scavengers was born.

[h2]What kind of game is Void Scavengers?[/h2]
Void Scavengers is a sci-fi co-op horror game about exploring and doing objectives in abandoned, procedurally generated space stations.

You can play solo, or with your crew (up to 4 members)! You'll use your terminal to find missions nearby and complete them. With each mission, you'll earn money which you can use to upgrade your items/passive abilities and purchase cosmetics.

[h2]Current state of the game[/h2]
Void Scavengers is still in early development, but coming in hot and strong! Most functionality is in place and I'm constantly working on polishing and adding additional content, trying my best to get the game ready for EA. I cannot wait to share more progress with you!
